items.question: Do I need a reservation in advance?
items.answer: We recommend booking via WhatsApp, especially on weekends and special dates.

items.question: Do you have vegetarian options?
items.answer: Yes. We offer several vegetarian dishes across starters, pasta, and lasagna options.

items.question: Do you offer delivery?
items.answer: Yes. Contact us on WhatsApp to confirm delivery coverage and availability.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept different payment methods. Message us to confirm current options for dine-in or delivery.
